_comment: Hand-picked teams with a story worth following — players choose one to root for. Scoring depends only on how far the team advances (see scoring.js), not on which team is picked. Listed alphabetically; display order follows this file.
pays_if: the team reaches the Round of 16 or beyond — points grow the further they go

teams.name: Croatia
teams.story: 2018 finalists, 2022 bronze — and Modrić still running the show, surely for the last time.

teams.name: Egypt
teams.story: Mohamed Salah's long-awaited World Cup stage, and likely his only shot at it.

teams.name: Japan
teams.story: Beat Germany and Spain in 2022. Nobody wants them in their group.

teams.name: Mexico
teams.story: Co-hosts with a deafening home crowd, chasing a first run past the Round of 16.

teams.name: Morocco
teams.story: The 2022 semi-finalists who stunned the world — Africa's deepest run ever, back for more.

teams.name: Norway
teams.story: Haaland's World Cup debut, and Norway's first appearance since 1998.

teams.name: Uruguay
teams.story: Two titles from a nation of 3.4 million — football's eternal overachievers.

teams.name: USA
teams.story: Co-hosts on home soil, built around a fearless young core led by Pulisic.
